title: Initial dr-validator umbrella + openbao validator (proving ground)
description:
Phase 2 of the DR program (per machines_conf:.omc/specs/deep-interview-dr-program.md). Establishes the dr-validator umbrella elixir app: AppValidator behaviour, Runner GenServer, perimeter loader, Report writer, CLI (mix task + escript), Wallaby+chromium plumbing, and ships ONE end-to-end validator (openbao) as the proving ground for the contract.

Acceptance:
- Adding a second app validator (postgres, zitadel, etc.) follows a single template path with no surprises
- mix.nix builds reproducibly; nix build .#default produces a usable escript
- openbao validator runs end-to-end against a local bao server -dev and passes
- report.json schema is versioned and stable for downstream consumption
- CI green (nix build + mix format + mix test + dialyzer)

Out of scope for this epic: postgres validator, zitadel validator, normatix-cloud validator, integration with machines_conf canary path (cross-repo work happens later when DR program meta-epic is initialized in machines_conf).

title: Spec: TLA+ model of Runner state machine
description:
TLA+ specification at `apps/dr_validator/spec/runner.tla` modeling the validator Runner state machine.

States: Idle, LoadingPerimeter, RunningApp, AggregatingResult, WritingReport, Done, Failed.
Variables: perimeter, app_queue, results, current_app, report_state.
Actions: LoadPerimeter, StartApp, AppPass, AppFail, FinalizeReport, EmitReport.
Invariants:
  - Every app in perimeter eventually has a result OR Failed is reached
  - Report monotonically grows (no app result lost)
  - No two apps run concurrently in single-runner mode
  - Report write is atomic from observer POV (tmpfile + rename)

Closes only with: .tla file present + TLC passing + code-reviewer audit + analyst audit. Per project TLA+ gate convention.

title: Convert template flake.nix to dr-validator umbrella; mix new --umbrella
description:
Replace the elixir template flake.nix scaffolding with dr-validator-specific shape:
- Rename pname/version
- Lock to specific elixir + erlang versions (matches machines_conf nixpkgs channel for cross-repo compat)
- Prune dev shell: drop `act` if unused; keep openbao + dex (needed for openbao validator integration test)
- Drop template README references; rename `elixir-app` derivation to `dr-validator`

Initialize umbrella mix project structure:
- `mix new . --umbrella`
- Create `apps/dr_validator/` (the umbrella core: behaviour, Runner, Report, CLI)
- Reserve namespace pattern: `apps/dr_validator_<service>/` for per-app sub-apps (created later per validator)
- Update root `mix.exs` for umbrella config

title: Define DrValidator.AppValidator behaviour + Report struct schema
description:
Module `DrValidator.AppValidator` defines a behaviour with required callbacks:
  - `@callback name() :: String.t()` — canonical name for report keys
  - `@callback run(opts :: map()) :: {:ok, AppResult.t()} | {:error, AppResult.t()}`
  - `@callback expected_data() :: map() | nil` — optional: declares expected restored entities for stronger assertions

Module `DrValidator.Report` defines a versioned struct:
  - schema_version (int, starts at 1)
  - started_at, completed_at (DateTime)
  - perimeter_id (string)
  - overall_status (:passed | :failed | :partial)
  - apps: [%AppResult{name, status, duration_ms, started_at, completed_at, error_message, details}]

JSON encoding via Jason. Schema doc lives in mdBook content (T12).

Closes with: behaviour + struct compiled + unit tests covering all branches of overall_status derivation.

title: Implement DrValidator.Runner GenServer
description:
GenServer module `DrValidator.Runner`:
  - `start_link(perimeter_id, opts)` — opts include report_path, app_timeout_ms
  - On start: loads perimeter (delegates to PerimeterLoader, T05), iterates perimeter.apps
  - For each app: looks up validator module via Apps registry, calls AppValidator.run/1 with sandboxed opts
  - Times out per-app at app_timeout_ms (default 5 min); failure → AppResult{status: :failed, error_message}
  - Aggregates AppResults into Report (T03 schema)
  - On completion: delegates to ReportWriter (T06)

Sequential execution only — no concurrent apps (mirrors TLA+ invariant from T01). Concurrent execution can be a future task; out of scope here.

ExUnit tests cover: empty perimeter, single-app pass, single-app fail, app timeout, app crash mid-run.

title: Implement perimeter spec loader
description:
Module `DrValidator.PerimeterLoader`:
  - Reads perimeter spec from a configurable path (default: /etc/dr-perimeters.json, overridable via env DR_PERIMETERS_PATH)
  - JSON format matches what machines_conf NixOS module emits: list of perimeters with {id, host, apps, canary, archiveAgeDaysMax}
  - `get(perimeter_id)` returns parsed perimeter or {:error, :not_found}
  - `list()` returns all perimeters
  - Validates schema on load; rejects malformed entries with structured error

ExUnit tests cover: missing file, malformed JSON, unknown perimeter id, valid load.

Reads spec from machines_conf:.omc/specs/deep-interview-dr-program.md for the perimeter JSON shape.
